import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "src"))

from do_again.service.daemon import _pending_outbox, _read_outbox
from do_again.service.runtime import runtime_layout

state = runtime_layout(repo).state_dir
items = []
for path in _pending_outbox(state):
    receipt = _read_outbox(path)
    items.append({
        "file": path.name,
        "request_id": receipt.get("request_id"),
        "state": receipt.get("state"),
    })

uid = os.getuid()
label = "io.github.tran-steven.do-again.41857a676462"
proc = subprocess.run(
    ["launchctl", "print", f"gui/{uid}/{label}"],
    text=True,
    capture_output=True,
)

print(json.dumps({
    "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "outbox_count": len(items),
    "outbox": items,
    "launchctl_rc": proc.returncode,
    "launchctl_excerpt": proc.stdout[:2500],
}, indent=2))
